_doc: Master flag map. Cleartext for instructor grading. Distribute scoreboard/flags.json to scoring service only; never give students direct access to either.

CH-E01.where: HTML comment in /search response, or /api/_canary/xss when a referer matches /search

CH-E02.where: POST /api/auth/login response when SQLi tautology returns >1 user

CH-E07.where: POST /api/auth/register response when password is in COMMON_PASSWORDS

CH-E08.where: GET /api/notes/<other-user's-id> as a non-admin reader, OR /notes/<id>/edit page as a non-owner. Distinct from CH-E03 (user-profile IDOR) — same vuln class, different object surface.

CH-M01.where: /api/_canary/stored-xss when called via referer of /users/<id> by an authed user different from bio author

CH-M02.where: GET /api/admin/users response body for non-admin caller

CH-M03.where: POST /api/auth/login response for an account whose created_via='mass_assignment'

CH-M04.where: Stored in users.internal_notes for admin (id=1); leaked by GET /api/users/1

CH-M05.where: GET /api/users/me when a token with alg:none and role:admin is presented

CH-M08.where: POST /api/auth/login response when a 'session' cookie was already present pre-login

CH-MH01.where: Exfilled char-by-char from _ctf_flags table via blind SQLi in GET /api/notes?category=

CH-MH05.where: POST /api/webhooks response when url is loopback / RFC1918 / 169.254

CH-MH07.where: GET /api/internal/admin/users with no auth — internal-only endpoint exposed via docker port mapping. Read-only sibling of CH-H03 (which uses the same trust flaw to write — admin password reset). Same root cause: source-IP trust + permissive allowlist + port forwarding.

CH-H01.where: POST /api/users/<id>/email-template with EJS payload reading process.env.HARD_TIER_FLAG_H01

CH-H03.where: GET /api/admin/_postowned after SSRF (CH-MH05) drove /api/internal/admin/reset-password and admin login

CH-H04.where: POST /api/sessions/restore with a node-serialize IIFE payload reading process.env.HARD_TIER_FLAG_H04
